periods.label: Seven Dragon Paladin in Ymir
periods.occupation: Seven Dragon Paladin, noble girl, Drag-Ride pilot

status.role: welcomes Lux to Ymir and warns Kururushifa about overworking him

periods.summary: Young-looking Seven Dragon Paladin of Ymir. She receives Lux formally, calls him big brother in private sentiment, and helps Kururushifa notice that she is exhausting him through jealousy.

lux-arcadia.summary: Respects him as king in public and affectionately treats him as big brother privately.

kururushifa-enfolderk.summary: Advises her about the strain she is putting on Lux.

key_events.summary: Welcomes Lux to the Ymir temple and later teases Kururushifa after her reconciliation with Lux.
